column2: [intro]
In my little head, I take a stroll,
A wild world where I escape my role.
No need for GPS or a map,
I get lost and love it, it's a blast.
Lost in my bubble, I'm flying high,
Ideas burst forth, it's a wild ride.
I'm a genius in my own crazy spree,
And I think it's cool, yeah, that's the key.
In my bubble, everything’s bright,
A rainbow of dreams lighting the night.
I write my songs, invent new tales,
And dance in my head, it never fails.
Lost in my bubble, I'm flying high,
Ideas burst forth, it's a wild ride.
I'm a genius in my own crazy spree,
And I think it's cool, yeah, that's the key.
[ solo ]
So join me, dive into the imagination,
Let’s escape together, it’s our liberation.
Let’s get lost in our wild dreams,
And find it cool, forever it seems.
[outro]
